title: CODE-ONLY-ORDER: give decision decision-2026-11-15-auto-ship-clean-1-merge-and-de a code consumer
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** ledger row has no code consumer
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/decision-ledger.json::decision-2026-11-15-auto-ship-clean-1-merge-and-deploy-every-change-automaticall ; its probe names an existing code or data file that enforces the decision, and the id leaves doctrine/standing-order-baseline.json
**Status:** closed

Turn the decision into a check, policy value or loop, repoint the probe, then run `python3 -m foundation standingorder --baseline`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 93.5 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
